brand.name: Holik
about: Holik makes firefighting and rescue gloves in its own facilities in Europe. Holik America brings its NFPA certified structural gloves and its extrication gloves to US departments.

products.name: Brenna Gauntlet
products.summary: Structural firefighting glove with a grain cowhide palm and split cowhide back. Certified by SEI to NFPA 1971, 2018 Edition.
details: Premium grain cowhide in the palm and split cowhide on the back. Brenna gloves deliver protection, comfort, and confident grip on every call.
features: Back: split cowhide leather, black
Palm: grain cowhide leather, black
Inner layers: thermo-protective layer on the back of the hand and thumb; aramid non-woven fabric for heat and cut resistance
Fourchettes: DuPont Nomex fabric between the fingers
Moisture barrier: Porelle P540 polyurethane FR membrane, a barrier against water, chemicals, bloodborne pathogens, and bacteria
Lining: thicker aramid lining that won't stretch or pull out, for easy donning and doffing even when wet
Lining stitched at the fingertips so it stays inside
Anatomical 3D cut for grip and fit
Gauntlet cuff, elastic at the wrist
Certified by SEI to NFPA 1971, 2018 Edition
Made in Holik facilities in Europe

products.name: Raven Gauntlet
products.summary: Structural firefighting glove in heat, water, and abrasion resistant buffalo leather, with a TPP rating over 60 and a PFAS free moisture barrier.
details: Robust construction with maximum flexibility, built for the demanding conditions of emergency work.
features: Back: grain buffalo leather, treated to be heat, water, and abrasion resistant
Palm: grain buffalo leather
Inner layers: thermo-protective layer on the back of the hand and thumb; aramid non-woven fabric for heat, abrasion, and cut resistance
Fourchettes: meta-aramid fabric between the fingers for dexterity
Moisture barrier: Porelle DXT, PFAS free, a barrier against water, chemicals, bloodborne pathogens, and bacteria
Performance Liner System: stays in place, brushed on the reverse for airflow and heat protection
Heat Shield construction with a TPP rating over 60
Unbound Thumb design for full dexterity
SEI certified total fluorine (PFAS) content below 100 ppm

products.name: Fury Gauntlet
products.summary: Structural firefighting glove with a hybrid leather and CeramX Shield shell. SEI certified to NFPA 1970:2025, TPP 60+.
details: Fury combines heat protection with dexterity, easy wet donning, and durable construction. The hybrid leather and CeramX Shield outer shell reduces weight and water absorption while delivering TPP 60+ thermal protection.
features: Back: grain water buffalo leather with CeramX Shield, an aramid-based textile coated with ceramic
Palm: grain water buffalo leather, black
Inner layers: thermo-protective layer on the back of the hand and thumb; aramid non-woven fabric for heat and cut resistance
Fourchettes: meta-aramid fabric between the fingers
Moisture barrier: Porelle DXT, PFAS free
Performance Liner System: resists stretching, attached at the fingertips so it won't pull out, easy donning even when wet
Unbound Thumb design for better dexterity and tool control
SEI certified to NFPA 1970:2025
TPP 60+
Total fluorine under 100 ppm

products.name: Blaze
products.summary: Extrication glove with a TPR protector on the back for impact protection, and Kevlar reinforcement in the palm. Debris cuff (Evo) or neoprene hook and loop cuff (Neo).
details: Protective gloves for first responders. The TPR protector on the back gives impact protection, and the anatomical design keeps the hand sensitive and comfortable.
features: Palm and fingers: synthetic leather
Back: elastic fabric, lime green
Thermoplastic rubber back and finger protection
Kevlar/PA elastic knit with FR coating and foam padding over the most exposed areas of the palm and between the thumb and index finger
Anti-slip reinforcements on the fingertips
Lining in palm: para-aramid, polyester, and fiberglass
Blaze Evo: debris cuff keeps dirt out
Blaze Neo: neoprene wristband with hook and loop closure
EN 388:2016+A1:2018: abrasion 4, cut F (TDM-100 test), tear 4, puncture 4, impact protection pass

variants.option: Blaze Neo (neoprene hook and loop cuff)

products.name: Lesley Plus
products.summary: Rescue glove for technical work, with cut protection level 5 in the palm, reinforced fingers, reflective knuckle padding, and a debris cuff.
details: A versatile rescue glove designed for technical interventions, with high cut resistance, reinforced finger protection, and a debris cuff.
features: Palm: synthetic leather, sensitive, strong, and abrasion resistant
Back: elastic textile, lime green
Palm reinforcement: DuPont Kevlar fiber/PA with FR coating and foam padding
Reflective, foam filled knuckle reinforcement
Anti-slip fingertip reinforcements
Lining in palm: para-aramid, polyester, and fiberglass knit
Debris cuff lined with elastic
Lining stitched at the fingertips to prevent pullouts
3D style with fourchettes between the fingers
Cut protection level 5 in the palm
Contact heat EN 407:2020 level 2: 250°C (482°F) for at least 15 seconds

products.name: Kaya
products.summary: Rappelling glove in goatskin leather and knit, with a heat protecting palm sandwich and a neoprene hook and loop cuff.
details: Rappelling gloves in a combination of leather and textile, with a comfortable fit and high sensitivity. The index finger has an overstretched seam to the back for more protection and longer glove life.
features: Back: Eurojersey Sensitive functional knit, PA/elastane
Palm: goatskin leather with hydrophobic treatment
Goatskin reinforcement on the palm, part of the fingers and thumb, the knuckles, and the fingertips
Palm sandwich protects against heat generated while rappelling
Lining: para-aramid, polyester, and glass fiber
Neoprene cuff with hook and loop closure
Plastic ring on the cuff for hanging the gloves on a carabiner

products.name: Penelope Plus Green
products.summary: Hi-vis rescue glove with a goatskin palm, TPR knuckle protection, and Kevlar reinforcement between the thumb and index finger.
details: Comfortable handling, high dexterity, and TPR joint protection make this one of Holik's most popular rescue gloves.
features: Palm and fingers: goatskin leather with hydrophobic treatment
Back: breathable elastic textile, hi-vis
Leather reinforcement over the back of the hand and fingers
TPR reinforcements over the knuckles and back of the hand
Kevlar fiber/PA elastic knit with FR coating between the thumb and index finger, over the side seams
Leather fingertip reinforcement
Lining in palm: Kevlar fiber, polyester, and fiberglass knit, highly cut resistant
Neoprene wristband with hook and loop closure
Terry fabric on the thumb to wipe sweat
Plastic ring for hanging the gloves on a carabiner

products.name: Vespid
products.summary: Lightweight, flexible rescue glove with a pigskin palm, EVA foam knuckle padding, and contact heat protection. Elastic cuff (Evo) or neoprene hook and loop cuff (Neo).
details: Designed for flexibility and comfort. Lightweight yet durable, with protection against mechanical and contact heat hazards in the palm and impact protection on the back of the hand.
features: Palm and fingers: durable pigskin
Back: polyester with silicone printing
EVA foam padding over the knuckles
Natural leather between the index finger and thumb
Silicone printing on the areas that wear most
Lining in palm: para-aramid, polyester, and fiberglass
Vespid Evo: elastic cuff with an inner wristband that keeps dirt out
Vespid Neo: laminated neoprene cuff with hook and loop closure
Contact heat level 1: 100°C (212°F) for at least 15 seconds

variants.option: Vespid Neo (neoprene hook and loop cuff)
